contexts.text: Abel = charity, which is love towards the neighbour. AC 341. AC 350. AC 366. AC 436. AC 916:2. AC 8093:2.
The offering of Abel = the worship of charity.
Cain killing Abel his brother = the extinction of charity with those who separate faith and set it before charity. AC 369. AC 436. AC 2417:5. AC 3325:11.
Jehovah had respect to Abel and to his offering = that all things of charity and of its worship were pleasing to the Lord.
The blood of Abel = the extinction of charity.
Righteous Abel = those who are in good of charity.
Abel = celestial love, or what is the same, good conjoined with truth.
